source.title: Data underlying the publication: Cryogenic Characterization of Low-Frequency Noise in 40-nm CMOS (G. Kiene, S. Ilik, L. Mastrodomenico, M. Babaie, F. Sebastiano, TU Delft)
source.files: main.zip: repository_for_upload_slim/measurement_automation/main/results/dc/*.npy (1,717 files; I3-1 download, 16.3 MB on disk)
source.reader: cryoml.explore.i6_1_tudelft.read_npy_dict: unpickler restricted to numpy _reconstruct / ndarray / dtype / scalar; run with python -I

selection: campaign 1 files (campaign = 'Standard triode (Vds = 50 mV) and diode (Vgs = Vds) sweep, 11 points, main bias exploration' in the dataset's campaign slides); devices with a campaign-1 file at file temperature 4 and 300. Other campaigns: 2 (1,400 files; 2 Id-Vg and 1 Id-Vd over Vg 1.05-1.1 V), 3-10 and 99 (debug, repeat or temperature-sweep runs on few devices) are not used
deck_temperature: per device and label, the mean of temperature_meas_start and temperature_meas_end of the file
process: commercial 40-nm bulk CMOS (foundry not named in the dataset); all 69 devices are low-Vt core devices, NF = 1; nMOS on sample (die) 3, pMOS on sample 5
terminals: voltages are Vgs and Vds (pMOS negative, source reference); the drain current is > 0 for nMOS and < 0 for pMOS; the files hold no bulk bias and no gate, source or bulk current; bulk is taken as tied to the source (Vbs = 0)

fitted_curves.rule: per device and temperature, the 12 Id-Vg curves (i_d_const_d; keys idvg@d0..d11 by ascending |Vd|: 0.05 V, then 11 values from v_diode_start to 1.1 V) and the 11 Id-Vd curves (i_d_const_g; keys idvd@g0..g10 by ascending |Vg|), 111 points each, 23 curves. The 11-point i_d_diode and i_d_triode arrays are not used
fitted_curves.note: the Vg start and the Vd / Vg matrix values depend on polarity and temperature (bias_grid) and are identical across devices of one polarity and temperature

inclusion_rule: frozen from the measured current only (cryoml.pdk2.metric): clean_current (zero the points before the last exact zero), trim the leading points up to the first |I| > 1e-10 A, denominator = mean |I| of the trimmed curve; a curve is included iff the denominator > 3e-7 A (Id-Vd) or > 2e-7 A (Id-Vg)

compliance.stated_in_files: no compliance or SMU setting is stored
compliance.check: a clipped curve would repeat its largest |id| over its last points; max_identical_values_at_curve_maximum counts repeats per curve
